en: Colorized historic view over a European town with red‑tiled roofs along a river in the foreground. Two people stand on a riverside path. Behind the houses rises a large Gothic church with multiple tall spires and an extensive walled complex or castle. The scene is printed in a painterly style typical of early 20th‑century postcards. In the sky area at the top left is a short German caption.
